notes: BUB1B compound heterozygote, mosaic variegated aneuploidy syndrome 1 (OMIM 257300). Allele 1 chr15:40209701 T>G, NM_001211.6:c.2210T>G p.Leu737Ter, nonsense, rs759242053, ClinVar VCV000533901.9 Pathogenic/Likely pathogenic with multiple submitters and no conflicts, condition Mosaic variegated aneuploidy syndrome 1; gnomAD v4.1 exomes AF 7.9e-05, group max 1.0e-04, 0 homozygotes; DP46 AD21/25 GQ99 PASS. Allele 2 chr15:40220612 T>G, NM_001211.6:c.3006T>G p.Asn1002Lys, missense, ultra-rare: gnomAD v4.1 exomes AF 6.8e-07 and group max 9.0e-07, a single allele in 1461878 with 0 homozygotes, and absent from gnomAD genomes. No ClinVar record for this nucleotide change; the same protein change reached via c.3006T>A is ClinVar VCV004600147.1 Uncertain significance. In silico: 16 predictors consulted, 10 damaging, 5 tolerated, 1 intermediate. AlphaMissense pathogenic 0.88-0.92, SIFT deleterious 0.0, PolyPhen-2 HDIV probably damaging 1.0, CADD phred 24.5, REVEL 0.472, MetaSVM and MetaLR tolerated. Computational evidence favours a damaging effect and does not establish one, so ACMG PP3 is applied at supporting weight with the disagreement stated; DP28 AD15/13 GQ99 PASS. Both on MANE Select ENST00000287598.11. Loss of function is the established BUB1B mechanism, so a nonsense allele in trans with a damaging missense fits MVA1. Trans is inferred from the recessive mechanism, not demonstrated: the alleles lie 10911 bp apart, Sentieon Haplotyper's GATK-format PGT/PID places neither allele in a phasing group, and no read or read pair in our own alignment touches both positions (median template length 502 bp, maximum 1103 bp). Confirmation would need parental testing or long reads.

LZTR1 chr22:20996720 C>G, NM_006767.4:c.2244C>G p.Tyr748Ter, heterozygous nonsense, rs1682503990, ClinVar VCV001409252.7 Pathogenic/Likely pathogenic with multiple submitters and no conflicts. Reported conditions: Noonan syndrome 10 (OMIM 616564), Noonan syndrome 2 (OMIM 605275) and LZTR1-related schwannomatosis (OMIM 615670). gnomAD v4.1 exomes AF 1.4e-06, group max 3.0e-05, 0 homozygotes; DP48 AD24/24 GQ99 PASS. Reported because it is an established pathogenic variant in a tumour-suppressor gene and a child already under oncological care is one for whom a second tumour-predisposition allele is worth a clinician knowing about. It is not proposed as a modifier of the presenting phenotype: nothing in this dataset supports that, and rhabdomyosarcoma is not among the conditions ClinVar lists for this variant. The epcr of 0.25 is an ordinal rank relative to our own rows, as the rules permit, not a calibrated 25% probability of causation: this variant is not proposed as causal for the presenting phenotype at all. Not proposed as the primary cause: MVA1 explains the chromosomal-instability presentation and the BUB1B pair is the better fit.
